<thought>From the 13C NMR data, methyl carbons appear upfield. The spectrum shows peaks at 26.40 ppm, 36.40 ppm (appearing twice, indicating two equivalent methyl carbons), and 58.70 ppm (typical for an O‑CH₃). This accounts for four CH₃ groups in total.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
